next.reason: 1985: VALUE 'must not be stated in a data description entry that contains a REDEFINES clause, or in an entry that is subordinate to' one, and 'This rule does not apply to condition-name entries.' §2023:13.18.63.3 SR12 states the same ban word for word, under FORMAT 1 (data-item). The condition-name exemption is kept by format scoping: the condition-name format imports only 'Syntax rules 10 and 17 above apply' (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR24), not SR12. Same programs accepted and refused; both compile-time.
